test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only 3 people are sitting between E and A when counted from the right of E. B is sitting 2nd to the left of A. G is sitting to the immediate left of F. Only 2 people are sitting between B and G when counted from the right of B. C is the immediate neighbour of E. What is the position of D with respect to E?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only 3 people are sitting between E and A when counted from the right of E.

2) B is sitting 2nd to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca0ef0c600ca55ee0369d167db216f901ba64ed4df323ebff17d1b63067d4205.png] 

3) Only 2 people are sitting between B and G when counted from the right of B.

4) G is sitting to the immediate left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7399d2f0f390c6f3f98f324bb151a44daf45e5cd597527afb7ce0d23f04963c.png] 

5) C is the immediate neighbour of E. 

After positioning C only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c738e8a5f7a622ababe93c7e3716ab88c34e56b8893de97a5e406a6f316c8c5.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D is 3rd from the right of E.

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
